note: A second language on the same loader output is technical parity, not a holdout.

priceFeatures.tieRule: a weekly close equal to its 40-week SMA within 1e-12 is an exact tie; strict > then depends on floating-point summation order (Python sum() is compensated). Accepted when the JS value lies within [python, python + ties/52].

liftTables.basis: price features from this implementation; fundamental feature values taken from the JS export (their PIT derivation is checked on a sample below)

fundamentalSample.definition: Simple ratios from the PIT document TTM facts filed before t (gross profit/revenue, operating income/revenue, net income/latest quarterly equity) vs. fundamental-inputs.compute; disagreements come from that engine's period alignment and quarter summation, listed not resolved

verdictScope: membership, forward returns, classes, price features and pooled lift tables; the fundamental sample is reported as an agreement share
